customers_say: Customers find the smart door lock to be of excellent quality and value for money, with straightforward installation and reliable performance. They appreciate its comprehensive features, including multiple unlocking methods, and find it easy to use. Customers consider it secure, with one customer noting the anti-pry/tamper alarm feature, and they like its premium appearance.

reviews.author: JEEVAN LADHE
reviews.title: Nice digital lock
reviews.body: Prakash Jangid was really prompt, came next day morning and installed the lock properly. So far I am happy with service and lock both.

reviews.title: Good Product, Excellent Support from the Technical Team – Installation Experience Could Be Better
reviews.body: I purchased the LA900 Lavna Smart Lock, and overall, I am happy with the product and the value it adds to our home security. Raising an installation request was quite easy. However, since my purchase was just a week before Diwali, getting an installation technician assigned turned out to be a nightmare. It took multiple days of continuous follow-ups before I could finally get someone to visit. reviews.author: Omkeshwar Singh
reviews.title: Great Smart Lock with Excellent Customer Support
reviews.body: Highly satisfied with the prompt customer service and quick installation. The smart features—face unlock, RF card, keyless access, and app integration—work smoothly. Premium build quality and fantastic value for money.

reviews.author: Smiti Mahabir
reviews.title: Good product, good features
reviews.body: The product is worth buying & the installation was very efficient & timely . The technician Lucky who came to install was patient & knowledgeable . All in all we are happy with the purchase & the service .
